subject: Temporary QPS safety net and discount approval request
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@fastflux.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@fastflux.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary QPS safety net and discount approval request

Hi Hannah —

Quick context: our mobile launch goes live this Friday (UTC early morning). Our traffic projection attached reflects a likely 6–10x burst in QPS for a 36–48 hour window. We signed the SOW last month, but we didn’t anticipate this spike pattern from our beta cohort.

Ask: can Redwood provision a temporary QPS uplift (200 -> 2000) for 48 hours around the launch window? Two commercial asks bundled:
- Temporary uplift (one-off) at pay-as-you-go overrun rather than raising our committed tier.
- A discount on the overrun rate (we were thinking ~50% off list overrun rate) or an equivalent credit against next month’s invoice to avoid a surprise bill for our CFO.

Why this matters: if we throttle we risk poor reviews and churn for the cohort. We want to keep operations stable and have a guarantee we won’t be hit with an outsized invoice without having a PO in place.

Attachments: FastFlux_Launch_Traffic_Projection.xlsx (traffic curves, expected peak windows), Signed_SOW_FastFlux.pdf.

Can you advise options and a quick path to approval? Procurement is on copy — they can issue a PO if we agree terms.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan | Head of Product
FastFlux
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fastflux.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procure@fastflux.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary QPS safety net and discount approval request

Hi Samira — thanks for the projection. I reviewed the attachment and spoke with ops about sizing. Short answer: we can stand up temporary headroom for the window you specified, but we need a quick alignment on commercial guardrails.

Options (fast paths):
1) Emergency headroom (recommended):
   - Temporary bump to 2k QPS for up to 48 hours.
   - Billed as PAYG overrun tokens at a reduced overrun rate.
   - Proposed concession: 25% discount off list overrun rate, capped at $35k for the event.
   - Requires a PO or written email approval by EOD tomorrow so ops can pre-provision.

2) Short-term commit lite:
   - Move to a 1-week elevated slab with blended unit price (lower than PAYG).
   - Requires procurement to sign a short addendum and payment authorization — takes longer.

If FastFlux prefers a larger discount (50%), I’ll need manager approval from Finance/Rev Ops. Ben / Laura — can you weigh in? If approved, I’ll issue the one-off amendment and route to Samira for a PO/DocuSign.

I attached an internal uplift estimate (Redwood_temp_uplift_estimate_20270520.xlsx) with ballpark pricing and the capped concession math.

Samira — if you can confirm which option you prefer (1 or 2) and give go/no-go on the $35k cap (or propose a different cap), I’ll move it to legal/finance for sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary QPS safety net and discount approval request

Hannah / Ben — I reviewed the estimate and timelines. Approve the emergency headroom path with a one-off concession as follows:

- Approve Option 1 (Emergency headroom) for 48 hours at 2k QPS.
- Approve a 40% discount off list overrun rate (intermediate between Hannah's proposed 25% and Samira's 50%).
- Cap Redwood liability to $40,000 for the event. Any overrun beyond that amount will revert to standard PAYG at list rate (customer will be notified in real-time).
- Waive the expedited support fee for this event.

Operational notes: Hannah, please get a PO from Procurement or a signed DocuSign amendment by EOD tomorrow. Ops: pre-provision with the uplift guardrail; enable real-time spend alerting to both FastFlux and Redwood billing. Finance: please prepare a short memo for internal record.

Samira — once we have the PO or DocuSign signature we will confirm provisioning window and provide a dedicated Slack channel for live support during launch. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/FF-Launch-Amendment

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
